answer.summary: ArchUnit test catalog_items_repository_access_is_reviewed fails deterministically: the new CatalogScenarioOfferService injects CatalogItemRepository and calls findVersion directly, which the architecture rule forbids outside the allowed catalog services. This comes from the change itself, so a rerun will fail the same way. Fix by routing that access through an allowed service or updating the reviewed rule.

evidence.quote: Architecture Violation [Priority: MEDIUM] - Rule 'no classes that do not belong to any of [io.openaev.service.catalog.CatalogService, io.openaev.service.catalog.CatalogListService, io.openaev.service.catalog.payload.CatalogPayloadOfferService, io.openaev.service.catalog.payload.CatalogPayloadStatuses] should depend on classes that are assignable to io.openaev.database.repository.CatalogItemReposit

Method <io.openaev.service.catalog.scenario.CatalogScenarioOfferService.payloads(io.openaev.database.model.catalog.CatalogScenario)> calls method <io.openaev.database.repository.CatalogItemRepository.findVersion(java.lang.Class, java.lang.String, java.lang.String)> in (CatalogScenarioOfferService.java:63)
